dependencies: FIBIU-20 — gated on the FIBDB-053 external PREPARED_G2 gate; AUTHORING only per PVRI-16
FIBIU-26 — Wave 5; every control naming a public route or an anonymous read is unrunnable until this node closes
AG-1 — governed ops configuration carrying the PVRI-09 thresholds. P-16 asserts the counter EXISTS and FIRES; it cannot assert a numeral until AG-1 is ratified.
AG-2 — ratified HTTP status for the REVOKED representation. P-08 asserts the BODY; it cannot assert a status code until AG-2 is ratified.
AG-3 — ratified response to a normal rate-limit refusal. N-08b asserts only that it is NOT the NOT_FOUND collapse.
AG-4 — ratified response to a document render failure. N-10 asserts only that it is NOT the NOT_FOUND collapse and serves no partial document.
AG-5 — ratified bound for the in-process degraded limiter. P-14 asserts BOUNDED, not a numeral.
AG-6 — ratified scope of the Crockford confusable input mapping. P-10 asserts case-insensitivity; the I/L/O mapping is asserted only once AG-6 closes.
AG-7 — ratified cache directive tokens and any DOCUMENT-representation ceiling.

postgres_requirements.rationale: N-15 (no anonymous SELECT on live tenant tables) and N-16 (the anonymous principal holds SELECT on exactly one view) are PRIVILEGE and RLS propositions. They cannot be proven by a mocked client, by reading SQL as text, or by an application-layer assertion — the LANE F7 census records that the existing capability-* tests are static text scans and that the live public-verification suite was never implemented. A real PostgreSQL probe on the disposable harness is the only evidence that settles them. Always via pnpm db:audit:disposable — never staging, preview, production, or the canonical local stack.

sentinels.purpose: A synthetic, non-secret canary locator in conformant PVRI-07 form, planted on a test disclosure. It must never appear in audit_logs.before_json/after_json, any admin log view, any exported log, any error message, any client-visible payload, or any telemetry sink. Proves PVRI-19.

A synthetic canary internal artifact cache key. It must never appear in any response body, response header, URL, redirect target, the canonical projection, or audit_logs. Proves PVRI-15's internal-only rule and PVRI-19's extension to it.

Synthetic organization_id, project_id and evidence payload markers planted on the fixture tenant. None may appear in any public response or in the canonical projection. Proves PVRI-20's allowlist and PVRI-06's FORBIDDEN_IN_PROJECTION list.

positive_controls.description: CANONICAL VECTOR TV-01 — reproduces content_digest_sha256 91f29946409b88808df663221ff02c31d463f53cc233f72f37a7fef6b7ba4481 from the frozen inputs, with a JCS serialization of exactly 894 BYTES. Byte equality, not string similarity. Computed as lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JCS with NO external prefix (PVRI-06).

CANONICAL VECTOR TV-04 — reproduces 396a129f00d2f19fb9438a8a824aaaca1506398259d1fc2216bf5b99adb1b4ab at 973 BYTES, exercising NFC normalization, an escaped double quote, guillemets, an em dash, a NEGATIVE net_social_value and a zero ratio at scale 4. Length asserted in bytes, never characters.

SECTION DIGESTS — every section digest in TV-01, TV-02 and TV-04 reproduces as the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 NFC section body with NO prefix, and each reproduced digest is the one embedded in that vector's frozen JCS. Catches a builder that computes correct section digests but embeds stale ones.

DIGEST CHANGE — TV-02 produces 56120b0513fd036c2a7f471659a37ae234857fbeb64d64d946f7cb4e74505550, differing from TV-01. Additionally asserts TV-01 and TV-02 serialize to the SAME byte length (894), so no implementation may use serialized length as an integrity proxy.

LOCATOR INDEPENDENCE (PVRI-05) — TV-03 feeds the projection builder TV-01's content plus a conformant locator, disclosure_state='revoked', an internal artifact cache key and an organization_id, and the builder produces a digest EQUAL to TV-01's. Proves the builder DROPS non-projection keys rather than passing them through.

SUPERSEDED IS DERIVED (PVRI-01) — creating a later version in the lineage makes the earlier version present as SUPERSEDED with ZERO writes to that version's disclosure row. Asserted by comparing the disclosure row byte-for-byte before and after, and by confirming disclosure_state is still 'active' and still drawn from {not_disclosed, active, revoked}.

SUPERSEDED SAFE CORE (PVRI-02) — a superseded version's locator still resolves and returns that version's safe core, explicitly NAMED as that version. When the successor's own disclosure is active and eligible, the successor's report_version and locator are present.

REVOKED REPRESENTATION (PVRI-03) — a revoked locator returns revocation STATUS and revocation DATE, and the response contains no report title, organisation, version, digest, figures, document, successor, reason or actor. Asserted as an exhaustive field comparison against the two permitted fields, not as a spot check. The HTTP status is not asserted until AG-2 closes.

REVOCATION PERMANENCE AND REACTIVATION (PVRI-08) — after revocation, republishing the same version produces a NEW disclosure with a NEW locator; the new locator resolves VALID; and the digest, snapshot, content and history rows are byte-identical throughout.

LOCATOR FORMAT (PVRI-07) — a minted locator is exactly 32 characters, every character within the Crockford alphabet 0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ, drawn from 160 CSPRNG bits. The frozen format vector fb79b7cf329543c52def25e8718e6aaefd77f9a8 -> ZDWVFKSJJN1WABFF4QM733KANVYQFYD8 reproduces. Lowercase and mixed-case input resolve to the same disclosure as the canonical form.

CACHE SYMMETRY WITHIN A REPRESENTATION (PVRI-14) — VALID and SUPERSEDED emit the SAME Cache-Control for the core representation, and the same as each other for the document representation. Compared pairwise between the two outcomes, per representation.

60s VALID-CORE REVOCATION LAG (PVRI-14) — with NO cache purge issued, the VALID core stops being served within 60 seconds of revocation. Asserted against the emitted Cache-Control lifetime and against the ABSENCE of stale-while-revalidate, stale-if-error and immutable. A test that purges the cache first proves nothing and is non-conformant.

REVOKED AND NOT_FOUND ARE NO-STORE (PVRI-14) — both emit strict no-store / no-cache, and neither is retained by a shared or private cache. Asserted by a second request after a simulated cache round trip, not only by reading the header.

LIMITER INFRASTRUCTURE FAILURE — CORE FAILS OPEN, BOUNDED (PVRI-10) — with the distributed limiter backend absent, unreachable, mis-credentialed and timing out, the minimal core page IS SERVED, and is served under an in-process degraded limiter that is BOUNDED: sustained requests beyond the bound are refused. Asserts both halves — that it serves, and that it is not unbounded. The numeric bound is not asserted until AG-5 closes.

LIMITER INFRASTRUCTURE FAILURE — DOCUMENT FAILS CLOSED WITH 503 (PVRI-10) — under the same four failure modes, the PDF / public_document path returns HTTP 503, for a disclosure that is otherwise VALID with public_document != 'none'.

DISTINCT-LOCATOR-PER-IP COUNTER (PVRI-09) — the mandatory counter exists and fires: one client address addressing MANY distinct locators is refused while a client address addressing ONE locator the same number of times is not. This is the control that distinguishes a scanner from a reader; a plain per-request counter passes neither half.

ONE-FIELD ENTRY ROUTE (PVRI-11) — /verify presents a single field; submitting a canonical, a lowercase and a mixed-case locator all resolve to that locator's route. The entry route is subject to the same governed limiter, including the distinct-locator-per-IP counter.

NOINDEX (PVRI-13) — the entry route, the locator routes and the document routes are noindex on EVERY outcome: VALID, SUPERSEDED, REVOKED and NOT_FOUND. Also asserts no sitemap entry and no robots.txt allowance implying enumerability.

ARTIFACT CACHE KEY BINDING (PVRI-15) — changing the content digest, the representation kind, or the renderer/version identity each independently changes the key. Changing the locator changes the key ONLY for a representation whose rendered bytes contain the locator, and does NOT change it for one that does not — so two disclosures of identical content share a cache entry.

PUBLIC CORE FROM SNAPSHOT ONLY (PVRI-20) — the locked public read path issues ZERO queries against sroi_reports, projects, organizations, sroi_report_sections, evidence_items, methodology_review_matrix or any other live tenant table, counted at the driver rather than asserted in prose. This is FIBC-032's own exit gate.

ROUTE MODEL (PVRI-12) — the public routes expose a dynamic segment named `locator`, and no route, column or user-visible string on this surface contains the word `hash`. Enumerated over app/**/route.ts and app/**/page.tsx, not sampled.

negative_controls.description: FOUR-CAUSE COLLAPSE (PVRI-04) — exactly the four ratified causes (unknown locator; not_disclosed; absent; ineligible) produce byte-identical responses: same status, same body bytes, same cache semantics. Compared PAIRWISE across all four, not each against a fixture.

MALFORMED LOCATOR — wrong length, out-of-alphabet characters, empty, a UUID, a SQL fragment, a path-traversal sequence, an oversized input and a percent-encoded payload each produce the N-01 response. None produces a parse error, a stack, a 400 or a 500. Pre-DB rejection is PERMITTED (PVRI-04) and the test must not assert that a database query occurred.
NO LOCATOR ECHO — the submitted locator appears nowhere in the NOT_FOUND response: not in the body, not in a header, not in a canonical URL, not in an og:url.

REVOKED IS NOT COLLAPSED — a revoked locator's response is NOT byte-identical to the N-01 response. It carries the PVRI-03 status and date. This control exists because R1 wrongly collapsed revoked into NOT_FOUND; it is the regression guard for that specific error.

SUCCESSOR NON-DISCLOSURE (PVRI-02) — when version N+1 exists but its own disclosure is not active or not eligible, version N's response is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the response it produced before N+1 existed. No successor identity, no link, and nothing from which the successor's existence could be inferred.
REVOCATION IS PERMANENT (PVRI-08) — a revoked locator never resolves to anything but the REVOKED representation, including after the same version is republished under a new locator.

NO LOCATOR ROTATION (PVRI-08) — there is no code path that re-points, re-issues or re-uses an existing locator. Attempting to mint a disclosure with an already-used locator is refused, and the unique constraint holds.

LIMITER INFRASTRUCTURE FAILURE IS NOT A NOT_FOUND (PVRI-10, explicit correction) — under limiter backend failure the core page response is NOT the N-01 response, and the document response is NOT the N-01 response. Neither failure mode is mapped into the collapse set.

NORMAL RATE-LIMIT REFUSAL IS NOT A NOT_FOUND (AG-3) — under a HEALTHY limiter, exceeding a threshold produces a response that is NOT byte-identical to N-01. The exact status is not asserted until AG-3 is ratified; this control asserts only the non-membership the correction requires.

DOCUMENT UNDER LIMITER FAILURE IS 503, NOT DEGRADED (PVRI-10) — the document path under limiter failure returns 503 and does NOT serve a document, does not queue, and does not silently degrade to an in-process limiter as the core page does.

DOCUMENT RENDER FAILURE (AG-4) — a missing snapshot element, a render exception, a render timeout and an unavailable asset each fail closed: no partial document, no placeholder values, no error document, and no fallback to a live-data render, under all four independently. The response is NOT the N-01 collapse. The exact status is not asserted until AG-4 is ratified.

AUDIT LOCATOR EXCLUSION (PVRI-19) — after activation and revocation of a disclosure carrying SENT-LOCATOR, the sentinel appears in ZERO rows of audit_logs.before_json/after_json, zero admin log renderings and zero exported logs. Queried over the WHOLE table, not over the events the test just wrote.
ARTIFACT CACHE KEY EXCLUSION (PVRI-15, PVRI-19) — SENT-ARTIFACT-KEY appears in no response body, no response header, no URL or redirect target, no audit row, and not in the canonical projection.

ALLOWLIST EXCLUSION (PVRI-20) — SENT-TENANT-FIELD markers appear in no public response. Additionally, every field in PVRI-20's exclusion list and every key in PVRI-06's FORBIDDEN_IN_PROJECTION list is absent, enumerated over the lists rather than spot-checked. The read model returns ONLY allowlisted fields: an unexpected extra field fails the control, which is what makes it an allowlist rather than a denylist.

STELLA NEVER PUBLIC (PVRI-20) — no Stella finding, disposition, abstention, governance-event kind, count, timestamp or existence signal appears on any public surface, including when the V-09 transparency note IS rendered.

NO ANONYMOUS TENANT-TABLE SELECT — under a real PostgreSQL probe the anonymous principal is DENIED SELECT on sroi_reports, projects, organizations, sroi_report_sections, evidence_items, methodology_review_matrix, sroi_calculation_runs and report_snapshots. Enumerated by querying the catalog for every relation the anonymous principal can read and asserting the resulting set, rather than testing a hand-picked few.

LEAST PRIVILEGE IS EXACT — the anonymous principal's readable-relation set is EXACTLY the one public read model view. Any additional relation, view, or SECURITY DEFINER function reachable from it fails the control. Also asserts that no new database role was created and that stella_0007 was not applied.

DISCLOSURE DEFAULTS (PVRI-08) — locking a report creates NO disclosure, NO locator and NO public reachability. Only an explicit authorized act does. This is the direct negative of today's crypto.randomUUID() minted at every lock.

INELIGIBLE LEGACY (PVRI-04, PVRI-20) — a report classified legacy_locked_without_pc01b_snapshot cannot be activated, collapses to N-01 if addressed, and any pre-existing verification_hash value is not migrated into an active disclosure.

DOCUMENT SELECTOR (PVRI-20) — with public_document='none' the document route refuses even though the core route serves. With public_document='executive_summary' a request for the full methodological report refuses. The funder preset is never publicly disclosable.

DIGEST IS NOT A LOOKUP KEY (PVRI-05) — submitting a valid content digest to the core route, the document route, the entry route and any query parameter produces the N-01 response. No route, index or cache resolves content by digest.
ENTRY ROUTE DOES NOT ENUMERATE (PVRI-11) — /verify offers no search, no filter, no browse, no list, no autocomplete and no suggestion, and returns no result set for a partial or empty input.

NO LEGACY REDIRECT (PVRI-12) — after the rename there is no route, redirect, rewrite or alias at /verify/[hash]. Asserted by enumerating the route tree and the framework's redirect configuration, not by requesting one path.

NO CALLER-SUPPLIED SELECTION (PVRI-12) — no query parameter on any route of this surface alters the projection, the document selection or the eligibility evaluation. Attempted overrides are ignored, never honoured.

mutation_controls.description: Deleting the projection EXCLUSION step (letting locator_token, disclosure_state, the artifact cache key or organization_id reach the serializer) must turn P-05 RED. If TV-03 still passes with the exclusion removed, TV-03 is testing nothing.
Removing NFC normalization must turn P-02 and P-03 RED. TV-04 is the only vector carrying characters with a decomposed form, so a suite that drops TV-04 loses this guarantee entirely.

ADDING any domain-separation byte prefix outside the governed projection — including R1's withdrawn `UELLIX-RCD-v1` / `UELLIX-RSD-v1` — must turn P-01, P-02 and P-03 RED. This mutation is the inverse of R1's rule and exists specifically to prevent the prohibited prefix being reintroduced.

Changing the section sort from ascending-by-section_type to insertion order must turn P-01 or P-03 RED. Requires at least one vector whose insertion order differs from its sorted order; the suite must verify such a case exists rather than assuming it.
Emitting monetary or ratio values as JSON numbers instead of canonical decimal strings must turn P-01, P-02 and P-04 RED.
Collapsing REVOKED into the NOT_FOUND response must turn P-08 and N-04 RED. This is the R1 error; the mutation is its regression guard.

Making REVOKED or NOT_FOUND cacheable must turn P-13 RED. A suite that only reads the header and does not attempt a cached second request passes a mutation that emits the right header and caches anyway.
Adding stale-if-error, stale-while-revalidate or immutable to the VALID core, or raising its lifetime above the 60-second ceiling, must turn P-12 RED.
Making VALID and SUPERSEDED differ in cache policy within one representation must turn P-11 RED.
Changing the core page's limiter-failure behaviour to fail OPEN WITHOUT a bounded in-process limiter must turn P-14's bounded half RED. Serving is required; serving unbounded is not.

Changing the core page's limiter-failure behaviour to FAIL CLOSED must turn P-14's serving half RED. This is the direct regression guard against reinstating R1's withdrawn hosted fail-closed posture, which PVRI-10 prohibits.
Changing the document path's limiter-failure response from 503 — to a served document, a NOT_FOUND, or a degraded render — must turn P-15 and N-09 RED.

Removing the distinct-locator-per-IP counter, or replacing it with a plain per-request counter, must turn P-16 RED. A per-request counter satisfies the 'many requests' half and fails the 'many distinct locators versus one locator' discrimination, which is the whole point of the dimension.

Removing the field-level exclusion at the audit-writer boundary must turn N-11 RED. The exclusion must be proven AT THE WRITER: a mutation caught only because one call site happens to omit the field is insufficient, so the suite must plant SENT-LOCATOR through a call site that logs the full row.

Restoring public verification by widening the connection's privileges, disabling RLS, or reintroducing a bypass connection must turn N-15 and N-16 RED — even though it makes every positive-path control pass. This is the mutation most likely to actually ship, because it looks like a fix.
Re-enabling automatic locator minting at lock must turn N-17 RED.
Declaring the successor unconditionally in version N's response, rather than only when the successor's own disclosure is active and eligible, must turn N-05 RED.
Permitting a locator to be rotated, re-pointed or re-used, or permitting a revoked locator to become valid again, must turn N-06 and N-07 RED.

Dropping the renderer/version identity from the artifact cache key must turn P-19 RED — otherwise a renderer upgrade serves stale bytes and the failure presents as a cache hit. Dropping the representation kind or the content digest must likewise turn P-19 RED, each independently.
Removing noindex from any single outcome — including the NOT_FOUND and REVOKED outcomes, which are the ones most easily forgotten — must turn P-18 RED.

Turning the allowlist into a denylist must turn N-13 RED: adding a new column to the underlying view without adding it to the allowlist must cause the control to fail, not to silently expose the column. A suite that only asserts named forbidden fields are absent passes this mutation.

Weakening any control in this manifest is itself a mutation the review must catch: relaxing a byte-equality assertion to a substring or shape check, replacing a pairwise comparison with a single-fixture comparison, narrowing N-15's catalog enumeration to a hand-picked table list, or asserting an AG-gated numeral that this manifest deliberately leaves unasserted. A test that has been relaxed to pass is a deleted test that still reports green.
